artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
**9:13** And the sixth warden engaged the next lock; and I registered a single signal from the tumblers of the vault, the reinforced one deep within the archive,

**9:14** directing the sixth warden-station, the one operating the seal-mechanism: Re-secure the four containment-keepers, the ones bolted upon the immense flood-corridor channel.

**9:15** And the four containment-keepers were re-bolted, the ones calibrated to the hour-setting and day-setting and month-setting and year-setting, so that they permanently intern the third of the magnitudes.

**9:16** And the tally of the impounded forces of the armored reserves: twice-ten-thousand-fold ten-thousand-fold; I registered the tally of them.

independent.recovered_law: In Text A the command is to RELEASE (Λῦσον) the four angels and they ARE RELEASED (ἐλύθησαν) to KILL a third of mankind; in Text B the command is reversed to RE-SECURE/RE-BOLT the four containment-keepers, who are RE-BOLTED to permanently INTERN (imprison) a third of the magnitudes — the direction of action is inverted from liberation-to-destroy to confinement-to-contain.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural inversion: release/unleashing is replaced by deepened containment/confinement, so that what passes through successive gates is permanently locked in rather than set free — the chain locks tighter rather than releasing.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion (9:16) maintains the reversed relation by describing 'impounded forces' and 'armored reserves' rather than deployed cavalry, consistent with the containment inversion throughout.
